description.en: City of the Cicones, sacked by Odysseus.
description.zh: 伊斯馬魯斯，基孔涅人的城市，被奧德修斯劫掠。

description.en: Land where the people consume intoxicating lotus flowers.
description.zh: 人們食用迷幻蓮花的土地。

description.en: A fertile island inhabited by savage, one-eyed giants.
description.zh: 一座居住著野蠻獨眼巨人的肥沃島嶼。

description.en: Floating island of Aeolus, keeper of the winds.
description.zh: 埃奧洛斯的浮島，掌管風的人居住於此。

description.en: Stronghold of the man-eating Laestrygonians.
description.zh: 食人萊斯特律戈涅人的據點。

description.en: Circe's island where she transforms men into animals.
description.zh: 喀耳刻的島嶼，她將人們變為野獸。

description.en: The dark abode of Hades and Proserpine.
description.zh: 哈得斯與珀耳塞福涅的幽暗居所。

description.en: Rocky place where dangerous singers lure sailors to death.
description.zh: 岩石嶙峋的地方，危險的歌者在此誘惑水手走向死亡。

name.zh: 斯庫拉與卡律布狄斯海峽

description.en: A narrow, perilous passage guarded by a monster and a whirlpool.
description.zh: 由怪物和漩渦守護的危險狹窄通道。

description.en: Island of the Sun God's cattle.
description.zh: 太陽神牛群居住的島嶼。

description.en: Odysseus sacks the city of the Cicones but loses men in a counterattack.
description.zh: 奧德修斯劫掠基孔涅人的城市，但在反擊中損失了部下。

events.source_excerpt: There I sacked the town and put the people to the sword.

description.en: Men eat the lotus and forget their home, requiring Odysseus to force them back.
description.zh: 部下吃了蓮花而忘記家園，奧德修斯被迫強制他們返回。

events.source_excerpt: those who ate of it left off caring about home

description.en: Odysseus blinds the Cyclops to escape his cave.
description.zh: 奧德修斯刺瞎了獨眼巨人以逃離洞穴。

events.source_excerpt: We drove the sharp end of the beam into the monster’s eye

description.en: The blinded Cyclops prays to Poseidon for the destruction of Odysseus.
description.zh: 盲眼的獨眼巨人祈求波塞冬毀滅奧德修斯。

events.source_excerpt: Hear me, great Neptune; if I am indeed your own true begotten son, grant that Ulysses may never reach his home alive

description.en: Aeolus grants Odysseus a bag containing all the winds to aid his journey.
description.zh: 埃奧洛斯贈予奧德修斯一個裝滿所有風的口袋，以輔助他的航行。

events.source_excerpt: Aeolus ... set about doing so at once. Moreover, he flayed me a prime ox-hide to hold the ways of the roaring winds

description.en: The crew opens the bag, releasing the winds and blowing them back to Aeolia.
description.zh: 部下開啟了口袋，釋放出的風將他們吹回了埃奧利亞。

events.source_excerpt: They loosed the sack, whereupon the wind flew howling forth

name.zh: 萊斯特律戈涅人的毀滅

description.en: Giants destroy most of Odysseus's fleet in the harbour.
description.zh: 巨人在港口中毀滅了奧德修斯的大部分艦隊。

events.source_excerpt: They threw vast rocks at us from the cliffs... I heard the horrid sound of the ships crunching up against one another

description.en: Circe drugs the crew and turns them into pigs.
description.zh: 喀耳刻對船員下藥並將他們變成了豬。

events.source_excerpt: she drugged it with wicked poisons to make them forget their homes, and when they had drunk she turned them into pigs

description.en: Circe restores the men to their human state after Odysseus confronts her.
description.zh: 奧德修斯與喀耳刻對峙後，她將人們恢復了人形。

events.source_excerpt: she went about among them and anointed each with a second drug, whereon the bristles that the bad drug had given them fell off, and they became men again

description.en: Odysseus visits the underworld to seek prophecy from Tiresias.
description.zh: 奧德修斯造訪冥界尋求特瑞西阿斯的預言。

events.source_excerpt: The seer will presently come to you, and will tell you about your voyage

description.en: Odysseus meets the shade of his mother in the underworld.
description.zh: 奧德修斯在冥界會見母親的靈魂。

events.source_excerpt: Then came also the ghost of my dead mother Anticlea

description.en: Odysseus speaks with the shade of Agamemnon about his murder.
description.zh: 奧德修斯與阿伽門農的靈魂談論他被謀殺的經過。

events.source_excerpt: the ghost of Agamemnon son of Atreus came sadly up to me

description.en: Odysseus meets Achilles and learns of his son's prowess.
description.zh: 奧德修斯與阿喀琉斯見面，並告知其兒子的英勇事蹟。

events.source_excerpt: As we two sat weeping and talking thus sadly with one another the ghost of Achilles came up to us

description.en: Odysseus has his men lash him to the mast while they stop their ears with wax.
description.zh: 奧德修斯讓部下將他綁在桅杆上，而部下用蠟塞住耳朵。

events.source_excerpt: they bound me hands and feet to the mast as I stood upright on the cross piece; but they went on rowing themselves.

description.en: Scylla snatches six of Odysseus's men.
description.zh: 斯庫拉抓走了奧德修斯的六名船員。

events.source_excerpt: Scylla pounced down suddenly upon us and snatched up my six best men.

description.en: Eurylochus convinces the starving crew to kill the Sun God's cattle.
description.zh: 歐律洛科斯說服飢餓的船員殺死太陽神的牛。

events.source_excerpt: Why should not we drive in the best of these cows and offer them in sacrifice

description.en: Zeus destroys the ship as punishment for eating the cattle.
description.zh: 宙斯為了懲罰他們殺死牛群而摧毀了船隻。

events.source_excerpt: Zeus let fly with his thunderbolts, and the ship went round and round, and was filled with fire and brimstone

description.en: Odysseus blinds the Cyclops Polyphemus.
description.zh: 奧德修斯刺瞎了獨眼巨人波呂斐摩斯。

description.en: Poseidon seeks revenge for the blinding of his son.
description.zh: 波塞冬因其子被刺瞎而尋求復仇。

description.en: The blinding of Polyphemus triggers his curse.
description.zh: 刺瞎波呂斐摩斯導致了他的詛咒。

description.en: Eating the Sun God's cattle leads to Zeus's storm.
description.zh: 屠殺太陽神牛群導致了宙斯的風暴。

description.en: The blinding causes Poseidon's ongoing grudge.
description.zh: 刺瞎事件導致了波塞冬的持續敵意。

unmatched_characters.note: King of the Phaeacians, host to Odysseus.
Priest of Apollo who gave Odysseus the wine used to drug the Cyclops.
The seer who prophesied Polyphemus's blindness.
A trusted crew member of Odysseus.
God who assists Odysseus against Circe.
